svg.title: From labeled examples to one new SMS
svg.desc: Three stages connect the ten steps. Prepare labeled SMS batches, set up the pretrained classifier, then fine-tune, evaluate and finally classify an unseen message.

g.text: Stage 3 · Fine-tune and use the classifier
1–3 · Download, preprocess, and batch the labeled messages.
4–7 · Initialize, load weights, replace the head, and define metrics.
8–9 · Train on labeled SMS and evaluate on held-out messages.
SMS → 120 token positions → two final-position scores → one label
